edges.reason: initialize requires msg.sender == admin before any state is set
_setPendingAdmin gates on msg.sender == admin
_acceptAdmin gates on msg.sender == pendingAdmin and non-zero
_setComptroller gates on msg.sender == admin
_setReserveFactorFresh gates on msg.sender == admin
_reduceReservesFresh gates on msg.sender == admin
_setInterestRateModelFresh gates on msg.sender == admin
seize passes msg.sender as seizerToken so the caller cannot spoof the borrowed market
transfer uses msg.sender as both spender and source
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for allowance checks
approve writes the allowance keyed by msg.sender
mintInternal forwards msg.sender as the minter into mintFresh
redeemInternal forwards msg.sender as the redeemer into redeemFresh
borrowInternal forwards msg.sender as the borrower into borrowFresh
repayBorrowInternal forwards msg.sender as payer and borrower
liquidateBorrowInternal forwards msg.sender as the liquidator
_addReservesFresh calls doTransferIn with msg.sender as the benefactor
_supportMarket gates on msg.sender == admin
_setMintPaused gates on pauseGuardian or admin
claimComp can be invoked by any caller for an arbitrary holder
delegateBySig binds the delegation to a recovered signatory rather than msg.sender
transfer delegates to transferTokens
transferFrom delegates to transferTokens
transferTokens calls comptroller.transferAllowed before settling balances
mintInternal accrues interest before minting
mintInternal calls mintFresh with the minter
redeemInternal accrues interest before redeeming
redeemInternal calls redeemFresh with the redeemer
borrowInternal accrues interest before borrowing
borrowInternal calls borrowFresh with the borrower
liquidateBorrowInternal accrues interest on the borrowed market
liquidateBorrowInternal calls liquidateBorrowFresh
liquidateBorrowFresh repays the borrower debt through repayBorrowFresh
liquidateBorrowFresh makes an external collateral seize call to another market
in-kind liquidation routes to seizeInternal instead of an external call
seize forwards the caller as seizerToken into seizeInternal
seizeInternal calls comptroller.seizeAllowed before moving balances
mintFresh calls comptroller.mintAllowed
redeemFresh calls comptroller.redeemAllowed
borrowFresh calls comptroller.borrowAllowed
repayBorrowFresh calls comptroller.repayBorrowAllowed
mintFresh performs doTransferIn from the minter before updating supply
repayBorrowFresh performs doTransferIn before writing borrow state
_addReservesFresh performs doTransferIn from msg.sender
redeemFresh performs doTransferOut before writing totalSupply and accountTokens
borrowFresh performs doTransferOut before writing accountBorrows and totalBorrows
_reduceReservesFresh performs doTransferOut to the admin
claimComp pays out COMP through an external token transfer
Unitroller fallback delegatecalls all calldata into the mutable implementation address
delegateBySig authorizes delegation through ecrecover of a caller-supplied signature
delegateBySig delegates to the internal checkpoint mover
COMP balance updates accompany token transfers during checkpointing
liquidity computation calls getAccountSnapshot on each account asset
liquidity computation reads underlying prices from the oracle
accrueInterest writes the compounded borrowIndex
accrueInterest adds accumulated interest into totalBorrows
accrueInterest adds reserve share into totalReserves
borrowFresh adds borrowAmount to totalBorrows after an addUInt overflow check
seizeInternal adds the protocol seize amount to totalReserves
seizeInternal subtracts protocol seize tokens from totalSupply
redeemFresh subtracts redeemTokens from totalSupply via subUInt
mintFresh adds mintTokens to totalSupply via addUInt
transferTokens decrements/increments accountTokens with checked math
transferTokens decrements the spender allowance unless infinite
initialize reads the admin state variable for its caller check
mintFresh reads the comptroller state variable to invoke policy hooks
liquidateBorrowFresh reads the comptroller for liquidation policy
accrueInterest reads interestRateModel.getBorrowRate for the accrual rate
accrueInterest reads accrualBlockNumber and subtracts it from the current block
repayBorrowFresh stores the current borrowIndex as the interest index
seizeInternal multiplies seizeTokens by protocolSeizeShareMantissa
the nonReentrant guard on seize state toggles _notEntered around the call
_setMintPaused verifies markets[].isListed before pausing
_setMintPaused writes the mintGuardianPaused flag
distributeSupplierComp adds supplierDelta into compAccrued
setCompSpeedInternal refreshes the supply index before changing speed
liquidity computation reads the oracle state variable for asset prices
mintAmount parameter flows into mintFresh for exchange-rate conversion
borrowAmount parameter flows into borrowFresh balance math
borrowAmount is passed to doTransferOut for the external payout
repayAmount parameter selects the transferred amount or full-balance repayment
account parameter selects which account's assets are iterated for liquidity
newPendingAdmin parameter is stored as the pending administrator
spender parameter is the allowance mapping key in approve
dst parameter is the recipient of the transferred cTokens
startingAllowance is decremented with subUInt inside transferTokens
MintLocalVars holds overflow-checked mint token and supply computations
RedeemLocalVars holds underflow-checked redeem computations
BorrowLocalVars holds overflow-checked borrow balance computations
borrowRateMantissa is validated against borrowRateMaxMantissa before use
blockDelta is computed by subUInt from current and prior accrual block numbers

normalization_plan.reason: The mint amount caller parameter is only meaningful inside mintFresh and should be folded into that function node
The borrow amount parameter is consumed only by borrowFresh balance math
The repay amount parameter directs repayBorrowFresh and can be absorbed there
The account parameter is only used to select assets inside the liquidity computation
The new pending admin parameter is stored directly by _setPendingAdmin
The spender parameter is only used as the allowance mapping key in approve
The destination parameter is only meaningful as the transfer recipient
The starting allowance local is a transient computation consumed inside transferTokens
The MintLocalVars struct is transient scratch storage local to mintFresh
The RedeemLocalVars struct is transient scratch storage local to redeemFresh
The BorrowLocalVars struct is transient scratch storage local to borrowFresh
The borrow rate local is read from the interest rate model only during accrueInterest
The block delta local is only used for interest accrual arithmetic inside accrueInterest
